_comment: Which videos the public site may embed, and their ids. Videos 2, 4 and 5 are present with public:false and no id, so the theme cannot embed them even by mistake — components/video-block.php refuses to render a video whose public flag is false, and renders the gate card instead of a player when a public video has no id yet.
